How do I use it properly the very first time?
To play Up or Down? for the first time, simply open the box—it comes complete with everything you need, including a clear rulebook!
During the game, players build ascending and descending columns of cards on the table. The core objective is to collect cards of the same color in a column—the more cards of the same color you gather, the more points you score at the end of the game.
